label: Dei Filius LORD_2 and BLESSED_2 derived from the nine, with sense bridges to the primitives
summary: Follow-up to attempt b93ce632 (next test: give typed content to the Dei Filius primitives). Target: the lord (Primitives.IsLord) and most-blessed (Primitives.MostBlessed) conjuncts of the restated sufficiency 5fbea2f5 and the Dei Filius root c0f4a346. The primitives stay (LORD_1, BLESSED_1); typed SIBLING readings are added, not identified with them (disambiguations aa1de96a LORD and 70f4f510 BLESSED). LORD_2 (definition c8e458bd, IsLordByCauseAndGovernment): g causes the being of everything else (IsCreatorOfAll) and governs everything else (the q.103 Governs relation). BLESSED_2 (definition d0b7b32b, IsBlessedByUnderstanding): g has intellect, is PERFECT_2, is good as to being and is IN_ACT_3 in the respect of understanding (39f50105, reused from DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect, #1481; a first draft with a new primitive 'Understands g g' and a q.14 a.2 self-understanding bridge was dropped in favour of this reuse). RESULTS (spec specs/dei-filius-lord-blessed.toml, all Comparator-verified, zero axioms): (1) every being with the nine is LORD_2: the creator conjunct is contained BY DEFINITION in supreme goodness (not an independent derivation), and governance follows from one new bridge 123d394b (an intellectual, willing cause of the being of all directs every other being to some end, after q.22 a.2) and the existing sourced q.103 a.3 reading STMT-DIRECTING-TO-AN-END-IS-GOVERNING; (2) every being with the nine is BLESSED_2 from two EXISTING premises (9c2a5dfe intellect is the capacity to understand; 4728d5f4 that capacity is exercised or in potency, the POTENCY_3 to POTENCY_2 sense bridge) and the nine's pure act, composing the registered intellectualPureActOperatesFromCapacity with 'operates' read as act in understanding; no new bridge; (3) strength order: the old bridges bb3d4417 and dc3ec456 entail the new sense bridges eb6611a5 (LORD_2 -> LORD_1) and a23dd1ac (BLESSED_2 -> BLESSED_1), strictly (controls parts 2-3), registered as strengthens relations; the six older Dei Filius routes that use the old bridges now record strong_version_needed (they do not derive governance or act in understanding); (4) second routes for 5fbea2f5 and c0f4a346 with lord and blessed through LORD_2/BLESSED_2 and the two sense bridges (sense_bridges listed), composing the registered nineGiveDeiFilius and deiFiliusRoot on modified primitives; (5) controls: nonvacuity, strictness of both sense bridges, need for the directing bridge and for act in understanding, sense-mixing control. Computed frontier-diff: 3 support alternatives added, 3 bare premises added (directing bridge, two sense bridges), the q.103 a.3 reading now reaches the root as stated. CONSERVATION: not a separate conjunct; CausesIn esse is timeless, so the vocabulary has no typed difference between causing being and keeping in being (per se conservation 56989bd0 is itself without motion or time); no identification asserted. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard). Directing bridge 123d394b: its antecedent is HasIntellect, HasWill and IsCreatorOfAll as SEPARATE conjuncts, not causing THROUGH intellect and will (92c03350 leaves freedom unencoded); q.22 a.2's reason presupposes intellectual voluntary agency (cf. q.19 a.4), so the bridge also carries the unstated step that a being with intellect and will that causes the being of all does so through them. The relevant alternative is necessary emanation by an intellect (everything else proceeds from a first intellect by necessity of its nature): named, with a stated mechanism, no independent justification on file. Side effects (effects outside an intelligent agent's intention): the cases on file all involve a particular cause, and their mechanism, according to q.22 a.2 ad 1 (attributed, unpinned), is the concurrence of other causes not ordered by that cause; that mechanism is absent when one cause gives being to everything else. This is a reason from the cited reply, not a logical fact about the antecedent. Avicenna affirms providence (the First orders all things to the good and knows particulars in a universal way); the bridge is existential in the end and says nothing about the mode of cognition, so Avicenna plausibly satisfies it; his view bears only on a stronger reading requiring cognition of particulars as particulars, which is not this bridge. Deism (no intervention in particular events) concerns special providence, not direction to an end in the q.103 a.3 sense. Aristotle's prime mover and Plotinus's One are outside the antecedent through its will conjunct (neither is a willing cause; the One also lacks intellect). No substantive objection identified. LORD sense bridge eb6611a5: the power-to-authority step it carries is the SAME as in the old bridge bb3d4417; only the antecedent is stronger, so that step is not weakened. The power-is-not-authority objection (target: that step; mechanism: de facto causal-directive power does not confer a right to dispose) has established counterexamples only among agents that lack the cause-of-being conjunct (a usurper governs what he did not cause to be; a parent causes generation, not the being of the child in the q.104 sense, and not of everything else); no counterexample with that conjunct is on file. The workmanship principle (makers have dominion over what they wholly cause to be) is the bridge's content and remains open. No substantive objection identified. BLESSED sense bridge a23dd1ac: BLESSED_1 is read the Thomist way (beatitude formally in the intellect, q.26 a.2); Scotus locates beatitude formally in the will's enjoyment (fruition), which would be a further sense, not reached by this bridge and not typed; not pinned, no independent justification on file, so recorded as a sense fork, not as evidence against the bridge. Real gaps carried by the bridge, stated plainly (three): ex se, self-knowledge of one's own sufficiency (q.14 a.2), and that IN_ACT_3 understanding may be merely virtual. JOINT SATISFIABILITY of the whole premise bundle of each second route is not checked (unresolved); the controls witness the new premises together with the nine only. WARRANT AUDIT: no claim states the new bridge or either sense bridge; they cite q.13 a.7, q.22 a.2, q.26 a.1-2 as attributed motivation without pinned readings (logic first, attribution deferred). The q.103 a.3 reading is a sourced claim on the English Dominican translation. 9c2a5dfe and 4728d5f4 are open premises of #1481. No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: a typed account of authority (a right to dispose) so the LORD sense bridge can be derived or fail, for example from the workmanship principle restricted to wholly caused being; type 'ex se' (nothing other than g causes g to be in act in any respect) and test whether it follows at the root from firstness (IsFirstBeing) with a causing-is-prior bridge; restrict IN_ACT_3 understanding to formal act (DISAMB-IN-ACT) for BLESSED_2, or record that #1481's third premise already carries the virtual-to-formal step; type self-knowledge (understanding with oneself as object) if a q.14 a.2 bridge becomes the selected question; remaining primitives: immense and incomprehensible.
